name: AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop
description: Bring your multi-channel commerce and affiliate operations into Claude. AfterShip Channels lets you publish DTC or Amazon products to your TikTok Shop, keep inventory, orders, and fulfillment in sync, and track how each TikTok Shop is performing. Discover relevant creators and influencers for affiliate promotion, find the right partners for your products and video content, and prepare creator outreach — all as a native part of your AI workflow. Get more done across your selling channels with less manual work and fewer tool switches.

_published_faq.name: How do I add AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://mcp.aftership.com/channels. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop provides these MCP tools: check-billing-plan, check-onboarding-status, get-ecommerce-categories, get-ecommerce-stores, get-orders, get-product-listings, get-products, get-sales-channel-stores, get-smart-list-result, get-tiktok-shop-performance, and smart-list-products.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 17, 2026, alternatives to AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop in commerce-shopping on the Manufact MCP catalog include EbooksDepository, ecoExperten Energieausweis, PHS Pallets, Promotion Pros Catalog, and RCO-A2A.

_published_faq.name: Does AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop?

acceptedAnswer.text: AfterShip Channels for TikTok Shop is developed by AfterShip. It is listed as partner on the Claude connector directory.
